title: K-flatness of a complex of sheaves is detected on stalks
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $K^\bullet$ a complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then $K^\bullet$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the stalk complex $K_x^\bullet$ is K-flat as a complex of modules over the ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$: tensoring it with any acyclic complex of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules gives an acyclic total complex.

proof.text: Assume first that $K^\bullet$ is K-flat. Fix $x\in X$ and let $M^\bullet$ be any acyclic complex of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules. Form the termwise skyscraper complex $i_{x,*}M^\bullet$. By [lem-pc-skyscraper-complex], this is acyclic and its stalk at $x$ is $M^\bullet$. K-flatness of $K^\bullet$ therefore makes $\operatorname{Tot}(i_{x,*}M^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}K^\bullet)$ acyclic. Since stalks of exact sequences are exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](5), applied at each degree (a complex is acyclic iff exact at every degree [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]), its stalk complex at $x$ is acyclic, and [lem-pc-stalk-tensor-complex] identifies that stalk with $\operatorname{Tot}(M^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}K_x^\bullet)$. Since $M^\bullet$ was arbitrary, $K_x^\bullet$ is K-flat.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma Tag 06YB (label lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), forward implication

proof.text: Conversely, assume that every $K_x^\bullet$ is K-flat. For any acyclic sheaf complex $F^\bullet$, each stalk complex $F_x^\bullet$ is acyclic by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](5), applied at each degree (a complex is acyclic iff exact at every degree [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]). The stalk tensor identification [lem-pc-stalk-tensor-complex] and K-flatness of $K_x^\bullet$ then show that every stalk of $F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}K^\bullet$ is acyclic. By the converse direction of [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](5), applied at each degree, the sheaf total tensor is acyclic. Since this holds for every acyclic $F^\bullet$, the definition [def-pc-kflat-complex] implies that $K^\bullet$ is K-flat.
